thought.text: Sambil menunggu buka, saya rapikan profil akunnya.

reasoning_content:
The starter has a shots.js pattern: `?shot=start|play|end&seed=1` deterministic scenes. Great — the agent should implement `?shot=` scenes for the open-world game (e.g., ?shot=street, ?shot=car, ?shot=chase, ?shot=mission) and a screenshots script.

Now, at 15:00 UTC we create the repo. Meanwhile:
- Set profile (username, picture, bio)
- Write the build prompt

Let me set profile now: username suggestion. Account handle currently swift-robin-61. Pick "kebumen-motor" or similar under 32 chars, a-z0-9-. Let me use "kebumen-dev". Bio: "Builds open-world browser games with AI agents."

Picture: generate square PNG 256x256 with python (no PIL? check). We can generate PNG manually or use chromium screenshot of HTML. Simpler: use chromium to screenshot a 256x256 HTML → PNG, then upload.

Let me check profile command usage: `makefun profile --username <name> --picture <file> --bio "<text>"`.

Note: username change requires keypair confirmation (own account) — profile command does it.

Let me do profile after repo creation? No, do now while waiting.

Let me create the picture via chromium (square 256x256) and run profile.

action.command:
cd /tmp && cat > av.html <<'EOF'
NW
EOF chromium --headless=new --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --hide-scrollbars --window-size=256,256 --screenshot=/tmp/avatar.png --virtual-time-budget=1500 file:///tmp/av.html 2>/dev/null; python3 -c " import struct;d=open('/tmp/avatar.png','rb').read();print('avatar',struct.unpack('>II',d[16:24]),len(d),'byte')" cd /workspace/project/mf/gta6/gta6-01-kit && node cli/makefun.mjs profile --username "kebumen-dev" --picture /tmp/avatar.png --bio "Builds open-world browser games with AI agents. Made for make.fun's GTA 6 bounty." 2>&1 | tail -8
